retentionPolicy: Reuse one current core cache and one app build location for routine development.
Clean isolated comparison/sanitizer/compiler caches after recording results.
Retain compact logs/results and required screenshots; download/export large recordings or system logs only for a specific unresolved failure.
No new per-feature build cache should remain after its validation is accepted.
standingUserPreference: Keep temporary items while needed; clear obsolete copies when the investigation or verification finishes. Recorded in AGENTS.md.

followupRetention.note: Earlier preserved-all-evidence policy superseded by user request: keep latest useful raw result only, compact older evidence, and remove obsolete generated output. Main app consolidated to canonical build location.
